facts.text: Last Tuesday — Sora was 20 minutes late.
Witness report — mumbles in full sentences.

lines.speaker: N1
lines.name: Sora
lines.text: Late again, {player_name}?{w0.5} [i]Always[/i] the same with you.

lines.speaker: N2
lines.name: Jin
lines.text: [b]I can explain![/b]{w0.6} There was the bus, and then...{w0.6} [color=#ff7f50]the bus again[/color]?

lines.speaker: N1
lines.name: Sora
lines.text: You always say that.{w0.4} Last week it was the bus, the week before that your alarm clock, and the week before that you forgot we were meeting at all. So tell me — what is it this time?

response.speaker: N1
response.name: Sora
response.text: [i]Knew it.[/i] At least you're honest today.

choices.text: It really was the bus this time!

response.speaker: N1
response.name: Sora
response.text: Mm-hm. That's what you said last week, too.

choices.text: (Say nothing and stare at your shoes.)
Fact check: my bus app says 7:42.

response.speaker: N1
response.name: Sora
response.text: [fade start=1 length=6]You screenshotted the bus app.[/fade] Of course you did.

choices.text: Fact check: YOU were late last Tuesday.

response.speaker: N1
response.name: Sora
response.text: [wave amp=20 freq=4]That was ONE time.[/wave]{w0.4} And we don't talk about it.

lines.speaker: N2
lines.name: Jin
lines.text: [shake rate=25 level=10][font_size=26]WHY DO YOU HEAR EVERYTHING I MUMBLE?[/font_size][/shake]

lines.speaker: N1
lines.name: Sora
lines.text: [rainbow freq=1.2 sat=0.9 val=1.1][wave amp=9 freq=2.5]Because you mumble in full sentences, Jin.[/wave][/rainbow]

lines.speaker: N2
lines.name: Jin
lines.text: [tornado radius=14 freq=2.2]My excuses are spiraling out of control[/tornado] — can we pretend that's normal?

lines.speaker: N1
lines.name: Sora
lines.text: [u]Watch[/u] this sentence [fade start=3 length=10]materialize[/fade] from nothing.

lines.speaker: N2
lines.name: Jin
lines.text: [pulse freq=3.0 color=#77ffcc]Thump.[/pulse]{w0.4} [pulse freq=2.0]Thump.[/pulse]{w0.4} That's my conscience.

lines.speaker: N1
lines.name: Sora
lines.text: Slow reveal...{w0.3} [speed=3]OKAY I'M SORRY I OVERSLEPT[/speed]{w0.3} ...back to calm.

lines.speaker: N2
lines.name: Jin
lines.text: [delay=0.1]I dragged every single word out of my own mouth...[/delay] and now I'm done.

lines.speaker: N1
lines.name: Sora
lines.text: Then the lights flickered. [instant]EVERY CLOCK IN THE ROOM STOPPED AT ONCE.[/instant] And then everything was normal again.

lines.speaker: N1
lines.name: Sora
lines.text: One. Word. At. A. Time. Is. All. The. Drama. I. Can. Take.

lines.speaker: N1
lines.name: Sora
lines.text: This whole line is orange and arrives at double speed.
